rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for fabric as a material.

rows.note: Use this casual shorter word when referring to the physical cloth itself.

example.english: I want to buy some fabric to make curtains.
example.traditional: 我想買塊布返去整窗簾。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 faai3 bou3 faan1 heoi3 zing2 coeng1 lim2

rows.note: Use this mainly in writing or formal contexts for woven fabric or textiles.

example.english: This fabric is suitable for making high-end clothing.
example.traditional: 呢批織物適合用嚟製作高級服裝。
example.jyutping: nei1 pai1 zik1 mat6 sik1 hap6 jung6 lei4 zai3 zok3 gou1 kap1 fuk6 zong1
